commission.source_quote: The Platform shall retain a commission of thirty-five percent (35%) of the Net Order Value.

delivery_fee.source_quote: A delivery fee of Rs. 40.00 per confirmed delivery is payable to the assigned delivery partner.

hold.source_quote: The Seller's share shall become payable upon confirmation of delivery and shall be settled no earlier than forty-eight (48) hours thereafter.

promotion_funding.source_quote: Discounts shall be funded 50% by the Platform and 50% by the Seller.

provenance.notes: SYNTHETIC contract corpus — not a real merchant agreement.

refund.source_quote: Where a refund is issued the Seller payout shall first be reversed. Commission is refundable.

tax.source_quote: The Platform shall withhold tax at source at one percent (1%) of the commission amount.
